{{Quote|You ''must'' register!|The Rebel guard to a new recruit|<ref name="XW" />}}
This '''Rebel guard''' served onboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The guard's post was near the desk used to register new starfighter pilots prior to their tours of duty. He was on duty during the early days of pilot [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander's]] career.<ref name="XW" />
